thought.text: Admin account exists with local auth. Now the critical operational test — logging in through the web UI with the generated admin password.

reasoning_content:
The admin user exists (id=1, login=admin, email=admin@example.org, account_type=agent, authentication_type=local, is_active=1). Good.

Next, let's test an actual login via the web interface — that's the key operational check. I need to do the following:
1. Fetch index.pl with a cookie jar to obtain the CSRF token
2. POST the login with admin + password
3. Verify that I get redirected to the agent portal

Let me also check the daemon logs, installation logs, and security.key.

action.command: cd /tmp && rm -f qcookie.txt && curl -s -c qcookie.txt http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl -o qisutu-index.html && grep -oE 'name="[^"]*"' qisutu-index.html | sort -u | head -20; echo '---TITLE---'; grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' qisutu-index.html
